instruction: Two Storey School Retrofit IFC This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. Modify the starting model into a compact two-storey school and save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes. 2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 9 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, and 1 IfcStair. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcCurtainWall, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities. 6. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token classroom at least 6 times, toilet at least 2 times, and administration at least once. 7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the exact space names toilet block 1 and toilet block 2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
